annotations.title: Suggest visual styles for a clip

description: Use this when someone wants visuals, animation or a visual style for a clip, a Short or a script and has not picked a style. Pass the words as text, or a clip_id, job_id or episode_id from Slice to use its transcript. Returns a few ranked styles from the Slice library with a short reason each, plus the whole catalogue so you can choose with your own judgement. Show the person 3 to 5 options with the reasons and let them choose. They can mix styles or use none: there is no need to use a Slice style at all.

aspect.description: The frame shape, if known. Every style works in every shape; this only breaks ties.

clip_id.description: Instead of text: a Slice clip's clip_id, to use its words.

episode_id.description: Instead of text: a Slice episode_id, to use the episode's words.

job_id.description: Instead of text: the job_id of a clip being made or rendered, to use its words.

text.description: A transcript, a script or a description of the clip, up to 20,000 characters.

name: suggest_visual_styles
